subject: ALLOCATE statement
notes: NOT-IMPLEMENTED -> CONFORMS (kb/Work PB153, landed 2026-09-02). Measured before the fix: `01 TPT TYPEDEF STRONG. 05 F PIC 9(4). 01 V TYPE TPT BASED. 01 P USAGE POINTER. ALLOCATE V RETURNING P.` bound CLEAN, silently defeating the Annex D.9.2.2 type-safety guarantee. BindAllocate now applies SR5 through StrongTypeModel: when data-name-1 is a strongly-typed group, the RETURNING pointer must be restricted to that type. The wider finding recorded with it - `grep -rn StrongTypeModel src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler` returned NINE consultation sites across MOVE/CALL/ACCEPT/STRING/REDEFINES/RENAMES/intrinsics and ZERO in PtrBinder.cs: the strong-type use-restriction network had been built out compiler-wide and the pointer subsystem was never wired into it. That is why the landing also covers SS14.9.39.3 SR19/SR20 in both SET arms and SS14.8.2.3.2 on a nested CALL.
